workflows.name: Managing the Window in Front
workflows.description: GNOME gives the focused window four keys of its own. None of them need the mouse, and all four are bound out of the box on a stock GNOME session.

steps.heading: Fill the screen
steps.description: Maximises the focused window. The same thing dragging its title bar to the top edge does, without the drag.

steps.heading: Give it back its old size
steps.description: Unmaximises, returning the window to whatever size it had before. On a window that is already restored this minimises it instead.

steps.heading: Close it
steps.description: Closes the focused window — the keyboard equivalent of its X button. An application with unsaved work will still ask you first.

steps.heading: Lock the screen
steps.description: Locks straight away, without going near the system menu. Worth having in your fingers before you need it.
